🇲🇽🇵🇸 CASTRO CORNERS RUBIO ON ISRAEL'S NUKES — "MAJORITY OF THE WORLD THINKS SO," BUT WASHINGTON KEEPS THE LIE

In a hearing on June 4, Democratic Rep. Joaquín Castro pressed Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Israel's nuclear arsenal — as the US backs Israel against Iran on the very pretext that Iran might one day build a bomb. Rubio's answer: "the majority of the world thinks so," then refused to confirm Washington's official position and suggested they discuss it "in private." Castro had already sent a letter in May, backed by 30 legislators, arguing the US cannot run a "coherent non-proliferation policy" while maintaining "official silence" on Israel's nukes. The entire Iran war pretext rests on a lie everyone in DC knows.

🇲🇽🏛️ NAHLE UNCHAINS 199 VERACRUZ MUNICIPALITIES FROM AN 18-YEAR DEBT TRAP — STATE ABSORBS 75%, LIQUIDATION 6 YEARS EARLY

In 2008 a securitization scheme locked 199 Veracruz municipalities into a 1.2-billion-peso loan — by 2026 they had paid 2.5 billion mostly to interest and finance costs, with 1.5 billion still outstanding. Governor Rocío Nahle's rescue, approved unanimously across Morena, PT, PVEM, PAN, PRI, and MC: the state assumes about 75% of the remaining debt, municipalities restructure the other 25%, and the whole thing is paid off by 2030 instead of 2036. Federal participations start flowing freely to cities in August. The 4T undoing two decades of neoliberal financialization of public budgets — one state at a time.

🔥🇲🇽 EX-GARCÍA LUNA OFFICIAL ARRESTED — 266 BILLION-PESO PRISON FRAUD FROM CALDERÓN/PEÑA ERA

Alfonso Molina Díaz, head of Prevention and Social Readaptation under García Luna 2013–2018, was arrested in Mexico City on June 4 for embezzlement and organized crime tied to 8 federal prisons in Sonora, Guanajuato, Oaxaca, Durango, Chiapas, Morelos, Michoacán, and Coahuila. Projected damage to the treasury: 266.3 billion pesos. The state had already paid 75.66 billion through 2021 before the 4T renegotiated a 15% rate cut that saved 41.49 billion. Forged IDs, dollars and pesos in cash seized at the scene. He's now in Cefereso No. 1 — El Altiplano, the same prison that held El Chapo. The dismantling of the PAN/PRI looting machine continues, one signature at a time.

🚨🇲🇽 SHEINBAUM NAMES THE PLAYBOOK: "THEY WANT TO USE MEXICO IN THEIR NOVEMBER ELECTIONS AND ALLY WITH OUR FAR RIGHT FOR 2027"

Day after AMLO's letter denouncing US officials colluding with Mexican opposition, Sheinbaum thanked him publicly and called out the strategy by name. "They launched a very strong campaign because of their elections in November 2026 — they want to use Mexico as part of the rhetoric and ally with the Mexican far-right for the 2027 election." She tied it directly to the broader axis: the Mexican far right, the Latin American far right, the US far right, all working to slander Morena as tied to organized crime. Anyone claiming she doesn't govern and AMLO had to step in from Palenque, she said, is a misogynist. The script is named. The movement holds.

🍅🇲🇽 SHEINBAUM CUTS OUT THE COYOTES — TOMATO PACT WITH 18 STATES

Tomato peaked at 80 pesos/kg this season — pure intermediary speculation in a country that exports them. Sheinbaum just signed a four-point pact with producers, supermarkets, and wholesale markets in 18 states: direct sales, no coyotes, and national supply prioritized over exports. SADER launches a digital planning platform to match production with demand. State coordination, not the invisible hand. Headline price already down to 48 pesos.

REUTERS: Mexico Finance Minister Says Economy May Beat OECD Forecast
June 4, 2026 | 🟢

📰 Reuters straight: Finance min Edgar Amador says Mexico's economy may beat the OECD's 0.8% projection; a 700-billion-peso ($40.5B) infrastructure package — roads, ports, power — lands this quarter. "Last year they told us we'd fall into recession; we ended up growing almost 1%." 🇲🇽

🔍 Rare US-wire piece that lets a Mexican official speak without the recession framing tacked on top. Worth flagging when it happens — most weeks the same wire would have led with "stagflation" or "Pemex risk."

• "Last year they told us we were going to fall into recession and we ended up growing almost 1%"
• "international forecasts had previously underestimated Mexico's performance"
• 700-billion-peso ($40.5B) investment package this quarter

REUTERS: Mexico's Popular Former President Blasts Trump as US Ties Hit Low
June 4, 2026 | 🟡

📰 AMLO breaks 20 months of post-presidency silence with a five-page letter — accuses Washington of "interventionist and unscrupulous practices," calls Sheinbaum "the best president Mexico has had in our time," ends: "for the good of all, may the other Trump return." 🇲🇽

🔍 AMLO held to his lifelong rule against ex-presidents meddling since handing power on Oct 1, 2024. His return signals 4T leadership sees the DOJ/State-Dept escalation as exceptional — not routine bilateral friction.

• "interventionist and unscrupulous practices"
• "the best president Mexico has had in our time"
• "for the good of all, may the other Trump return"

NATIONAL REVIEW: Claudia Sheinbaum Puts Mexico on Collision Course with U.S. and Basic Democratic Civics
June 3, 2026 | 🔴

📰 NatRev: Sheinbaum's gov't is on "a collision course with the U.S. and basic Mexican democratic civics"; "Mexico's regime is dragging it toward the abyss"; "the damage will take a generation to repair." 🤡 Regime-change vocabulary for an elected president polling near 70%.

🔍 Sheinbaum won 2024 by ~32 points — the largest margin in Mexican democratic history. INEGI/Banxico approval consistently 65-72%. "Regime" is the word US writers reach for when they want a government toppled.

• "collision course with the U.S. and with basic Mexican democratic civics"
• "regime is dragging it toward the abyss"
• "damage will take a generation to repair"

WAPO: Mexico's Claudia Sheinbaum has found her scapegoat
June 3, 2026 | 🔴

📰 WaPo opinion: Sheinbaum "found her scapegoat" — frames the constitutional amendment letting Congress annul elections compromised by foreign interference as "anti-US rhetoric to avoid accountability ahead of elections." 💀 Defending sovereignty rebranded as deflection.

🔍 USAID/NED-funded Mexican civic groups (MCCI et al.) have received millions in US-government money explicitly to oppose Morena. The amendment responds to documented interference — not imagined slights.

• "anti-U.S. rhetoric helps her avoid accountability ahead of elections"
• "the most acerbic and aggressive speech of her administration"

Source: https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2026/06/03/mexicos-claudia-sheinbaum-touts-foreign-interference-amendment/

LA TIMES: The U.S. is investigating two more Mexican governors for connections to cartels
June 4, 2026 | 🔴

📰 LA Times: US "investigating two more Mexican governors" — Alfonso Durazo (Sonora) + Américo Villarreal (Tamaulipas). Both Morena. Both Sheinbaum allies. Both had US visas revoked. After Rocha Moya in April, that's three ruling-party governors in 60 days.

🔍 The pattern targets only Morena officials. García Cabeza de Vaca (PAN, ex-Tamaulipas governor, fled to US after Mexican charges) walks free in Texas — no DOJ attention. "Anti-cartel" framing only flows one direction.

• "stripped of their U.S. visas amid criminal investigations"
• Durazo "linked to organized crime networks"
• Villarreal "associated with fuel smuggling" (huachicol)
